message.content: {"winner":"B","evidence_A":"Keeps the inflated intro, recast as «привычки решают всё», which strengthens the claim. Changes «проверял» to «записывал». Adds a second paragraph of editorial commentary and an invented claim that the author stopped reading mechanically. This violates the format and no-addition rules. Phrasing like «выборка одна только я» is awkward.","evidence_B":"Removes the empty intro and keeps 15 minutes, 21 days, 17 evenings, four missed and the not-scientific qualification. It is concise, with no extra commentary. Minor defect: «новые книги» is an invented specific, since the source says «новые горизонты».","comparative_reason":"B follows the format and preserves the facts, with one small invented detail. A keeps the filler, adds an unsupported afterword with invented interpretation, and breaks the output-only rule. B is materially better."}
